ABOUT ME

About the things I love and build

I build software that moves with purpose. As a current sophomore at UW-Madison, I'm always looking to build my skills. I love the challenge of building a project from the ground up, and always try to apply myself to real-world situations. Outside of CS, I obsess myself in some of my hobbies shown here :)

The motive behind my work.

I knew I loved technology the day I stepped into my first high school computer science class. Immediately hooked by the endless possibilities, I knew that I wanted to become a Software Engineer.

Today, I combine my curiosity for sports, photography, and travel into software that feels dynamic, thoughtful, and fun.

I love shipping code that solves real problems. I move fast while staying thorough, and welcome challenges that push me to learn quickly.

Modern AOI System for Plexus

Built during a UW-Madison College of Engineering hackathon, this Automatic Optical Inspection system uses Raspberry Pi image capture, OpenCV preprocessing, YOLO inference, and Gemini-powered analysis for reliable defect detection.

FocusAI

A computer vision system that detects distraction in webcam streams using YOLOv8 and ResNet50, real-time embeddings, and FAISS similarity search for accurate distraction assessment.

Raspberry Pi OCR Summarizer

A portable image capture pipeline that extracts text from low-quality camera images and summarizes it through OCR and an NLP workflow.
